tools.name: knowledge_query
tools.description: Search reference notes by free text. Results retain known conditions and uncertainty; assess them against current evidence. Lookup is optional.

text.description: Question or symptom, with useful context.

tools.name: knowledge_capture
tools.description: Save a local Markdown note; the same title updates its body. Reuse an existing summary when useful; no template or separate report is required. Keep known conditions, sources and uncertainty in the prose. Sharing follows the user's existing publishing configuration.

tools.name: knowledge_explain
tools.description: Read the original Markdown and recorded context for a search result.
